arxiv-2110-05544.title: Effect of the Nuclear Equation of State on Relativistic-Turbulence Induced Core-Collapse Supernovae
arxiv-2110-05544.creator: Luca Boccioli, Grant J. Mathews, In-Saeng Suh, Evan P. O’Connor
arxiv-2110-05544.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Luca Boccioli, Grant J. Mathews, In-Saeng Suh, Evan P. O’Connor. The nuclear equation of state is an important component in the evolution of core collapse supernovae. In this paper we make a survey of various equations of state in the literature and analyze their effect on spherical core-collapse models in which the effects of three-dimensional turbulence is modeled by a general relativistic formulation of Supernova Turbulence in Reduced dimensionality (STIR).

arxiv-2306-02061.creator: Yuchao Wang, Jingjing Fei, Haochen Wang, Wei Li, Tianpeng Bao, Liwei Wu, Rui Zhao, Yujun Shen, [5pt] Shanghai Jiao Tong University
arxiv-2306-02061.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yuchao Wang, Jingjing Fei, Haochen Wang, Wei Li, Tianpeng Bao, Liwei Wu, Rui Zhao, Yujun Shen, [5pt] Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Semantic segmentation usually suffers from a long-tail data distribution. Due to the imbalanced number of samples across categories, the features of those tail classes may get squeezed into a narrow area in the feature space.

arxiv-2402-06624.title: Right or Wrong – Understanding How Novice Users Write Software Models
arxiv-2402-06624.creator: Ana Jovanovic, Allison Sullivan
arxiv-2402-06624.description: Abstract . Writing declarative models has numerous benefits, ranging from automated reasoning and correction of design-level properties before systems are built, to automated testing and debugging of their implementations after they are built. Alloy is a declarative modeling language that is well-suited for verifying system designs.

arxiv-2405-03787.title: Exploring Self-Interacting Dark Matter Halos with Diverse Baryonic Distributions: A Parametric Approach
arxiv-2405-03787.creator: Daneng Yang
arxiv-2405-03787.description: Abstract Galaxies residing in dark matter halos exert significant gravitational effects that alter halo structure and dynamics. The complexity of these interactions escalates with the diversity of galactic structures and the variability in dark matter halo profiles under self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) models. This work extends the parametric model for dark matter-only halos presented in Ref. Yang et al.

arxiv-2406-16449.title: Evaluating and Analyzing Relationship Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2406-16449.creator: Mingrui Wu, Jiayi Ji, Oucheng Huang, Jiale Li, Yuhang Wu, Xiaoshuai Sun, Rongrong Ji
arxiv-2406-16449.description: Abstract The issue of hallucinations is a prevalent concern in existing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Previous efforts have primarily focused on investigating object hallucinations, which can be easily alleviated by introducing object detectors. However, these efforts neglect hallucinations in inter-object relationships, which is essential for visual comprehension.

arxiv-2511-11092.title: Sheaf Cohomology of Linear Predictive Coding Networks
arxiv-2511-11092.creator: Jeffrey Seely
arxiv-2511-11092.description: Abstract Predictive coding (PC) replaces global backpropagation with local optimization over weights and activations. We show that linear PC networks admit a natural formulation as cellular sheaves: the sheaf coboundary maps activations to edge-wise prediction errors, and PC inference is diffusion under the sheaf Laplacian. Sheaf cohomology then characterizes irreducible error patterns that inference cannot remove.

pmc-10650605.description: Simple SummaryMadagascar is home to diverse ecosystems with many endemic reptiles, many of which are threatened by the increasing loss of their habitat. This knowledge gap hinders efforts to collect scientific information in order to conserve the remaining habitat.

pmc-11353545.title: The Impact of Gel Parameters on the Dispersal and Fragmentation of Hyaluronic Acid Gel Fillers within an Artificial Model of Arterial Embolism
pmc-11353545.creator: Danny J. Soares, Alec D. McCarthy
pmc-11353545.description: Accidental arterial embolization of hyaluronic acid (HA) fillers can lead to severe complications, including skin ischemia, blindness, and stroke. Currently, the intra-arterial dispersal and fragmentation behavior of HA gels is unknown but critical to our understanding of the pathomechanism of these injuries.

pmc-11443448.title: Volume-based structural connectome of epilepsy partialis continua in Rasmussen’s encephalitis
pmc-11443448.creator: Cong Fu, Xue Yang, Mengyang Wang, Xiongfei Wang, Chongyang Tang, Guoming Luan
pmc-11443448.description: Rasmussen's encephalitis is a rare, progressive neurological inflammatory with hemispheric brain atrophy. Epilepsy partialis continua (EPC) is a diagnostic clinical condition in patients with Rasmussen's encephalitis. However, the incidence of EPC in the natural course of Rasmussen's encephalitis is only about 50%.

pmc-12732433.title: Efficacy and Safety of IncobotulinumtoxinA in Older Patients with Upper Limb Spasticity: A Pooled Analysis
pmc-12732433.creator: Michael C Munin, Alexandre Camões-Barbosa, Carlos Cordero-García, Alessio Baricich, Stefano Carda, Michael Althaus, Georg Comes, Matteo Vacchelli, Jörg Wissel, Ralf Lobmann
pmc-12732433.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: The aim of this study was to compare the efficacy and safety of a single cycle of incobotulinumtoxinA versus placebo in pooled data from older patients (aged ≥65 years) with upper limb spasticity (ULS). Methods: This study was a post hoc analysis of pooled data from seven prospective, multicenter, phase II or III trials of incobotulinumtoxinA in adult patients aged ≥65 years from across the world with post-stroke ULS or upper and lower limb spasticity, including a subgroup with moderate-to-severe ULS.

pmc-13259054.creator: Cara J. Westmark
pmc-13259054.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: Folate is a water-soluble B vitamin that is essential for DNA synthesis, cell division and proper growth and development, particularly during pregnancy to prevent neural tube defects (NTDs). A large, fully randomized clinical trial (RCT) from the United Kingdom in 1991 (the Medical Research Council (MRC) Vitamin Study), where participants had a prior NTD-affected pregnancy, demonstrated a 72% reduction in NTD recurrence in the folic acid treatment group.

pmc-13557754.description: Introduction:Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), including ulcerative colitis and Crohn disease, is a chronic condition that affects the gastrointestinal tract and is associated with an increased risk of osteoporosis and fractures.
